questions.question: In Moses' laws for Israel, what was a newly married man free to do during his first year?

answers.text: Stay home and bring joy to his wife
Serve the priests at the tabernacle
Build a new house for his family

questions.question: When did Moses say a poor hired worker must be paid his wages?

answers.text: At the end of each week

questions.question: Under Moses' law, a man's brother marries his childless widow. Why does their first son carry the dead man's name?

answers.text: So his name isn't blotted out from Israel
So the widow can keep her husband's house
So the elders can count him in the tribe
